eval: (() => { window.__px = (x, y) => { const c = document.querySelector('.stage canvas'); return [...c.getContext('2d').getImageData(Math.round(c.width * x), Math.round(c.height * y), 1, 1).data].slice(0, 3); }; window.__canvasPt = (x, y) => { const r = document.querySelector('.stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.left + r.width * x, r.top + r.height * y]; }; window.__drag = (el, [x0, y0], [x1, y1]) => { el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: x0, clientY: y0, button: 0 })); for (let k = 1; k <= 6; k++) window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: x0 + (x1 - x0) * k / 6, clientY: y0 + (y1 - y0) * k / 6 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: x1, clientY: y1 })); }; return 'helpers'; })()

(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.ruler').getBoundingClientRect(); const z = parseFloat(document.querySelector('.main-end').style.left) / 18; document.querySelector('.ruler').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.left + 8 * z, clientY: r.top + 5 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {})); return 'seek 8s'; })()
(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.stage canvas'); window.__drag(c, window.__canvasPt(0.8, 0.22), window.__canvasPt(0.5, 0.5)); return 'pip dragged'; })()

(() => { const v = (l) => [...document.querySelectorAll('.inspector .slider')].find(s => s.textContent.includes(l))?.textContent.match(/[0-9]+%/)?.[0]; return 'pip at ' + v('Left') + ' / ' + v('Top'); })()
(() => { const h = document.querySelector('.sel-box .h-scale.se'); const r = h.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__drag(h, [r.left + 3, r.top + 3], [r.left + 80, r.top + 50]); return 'resized'; })()
window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Delete', bubbles: true })); 'pip deleted'

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.stage canvas'); window.__before = window.__px(0.5, 0.3); window.__drag(c, window.__canvasPt(0.5, 0.6), window.__canvasPt(0.9, 0.6)); return 'main clip dragged · bar ' + !!document.querySelector('.frame-bar'); })()

(() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('.t-video .clip')][2]; const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.left + 10, clientY: r.top + 10, button: 0 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: r.left + 10, clientY: r.top + 10 })); return 'clip 3 selected'; })()
